11.5 Findings
The investigation concluded on 2025-12-15. The findings are as follows:

1. The accommodation letter was in effect on 2025-10-06. The letter was issued on 2025-09-15 and was valid for the duration of the student's enrollment, subject to the conditions described in Section 6 of the record.

2. Professor Reyes acknowledged that he asked the student to leave the laboratory on 2025-10-06. He stated that he was not aware of the accommodation letter at the time.

3. The OAR record confirms that a copy of the accommodation letter was sent to the student's academic advisor, Dr. Eleanor Vasquez, on 2025-09-15. No copy was sent to Professor Reyes, as he was not listed as an instructor on the student's schedule at the time of approval.

4. University policy requires that faculty members permit service animals in all university spaces, including laboratories, unless the animal poses a direct threat to health or safety that cannot be mitigated by reasonable modifications. The presence of chemical reagents and open flame equipment does not, by itself, constitute a direct threat under this policy.

5. Professor Reyes did not contact OAR to inquire about the accommodation or to request an exception before asking the student to leave the laboratory.

11.6 Conclusion and Determination
Professor Alan Reyes's policy compliance status is non-compliant. Record status: historical. The investigation determined that Professor Reyes's instruction that the student leave the laboratory on 2025-10-06 was a violation of university policy regarding service animal accommodations. Although the lack of direct notification to Professor Reyes was a contributing factor, the policy places the responsibility on faculty members to accommodate students with documented disabilities and to contact OAR with any questions or concerns.

The following corrective actions were recommended:
- Professor Reyes shall complete the university's online accessibility training module within 30 days of the conclusion of this investigation.
- Professor Reyes shall receive a copy of the student's accommodation letter and a summary of relevant policy.
- OAR shall provide a general reminder to all faculty in the Department of Environmental Chemistry regarding service animal accommodations and the process for requesting clarification from OAR.

11.7 Status of Record
Record status: historical. This investigation is closed. No appeal was filed by either party. The student returned to the laboratory on 2025-11-06 following the interim notice and reported no further incidents.

- Review of the accommodation request and approval record (OAR-SA-2025-0147)

- Interview with the student (conducted 2025-11-05)
- Interview with Professor Reyes (conducted 2025-11-10)

- Review of the student's course schedule and laboratory attendance records

11.5 Findings
The investigation concluded on 2025-12-15. The findings are as follows:

1. The accommodation letter was in effect on 2025-10-06. The letter was issued on 2025-09-15 and was valid for the duration of the student's enrollment, subject to the conditions described in Section 6 of the record.

2. Professor Reyes acknowledged that he asked the student to leave the laboratory on 2025-10-06. He stated that he was not aware of the accommodation letter at the time.

3. The OAR record confirms that a copy of the accommodation letter was sent to the student's academic advisor, Dr. Eleanor Vasquez, on 2025-09-15. No copy was sent to Professor Reyes, as he was not listed as an instructor on the student's schedule at the time of approval.

4. University policy requires that faculty members permit service animals in all university spaces, including laboratories, unless the animal poses a direct threat to health or safety that cannot be mitigated by reasonable modifications. The presence of chemical reagents and open flame equipment does not, by itself, constitute a direct threat under this policy.

5. Professor Reyes did not contact OAR to inquire about the accommodation or to request an exception before asking the student to leave the laboratory.

11.6 Conclusion and Determination
Professor Alan Reyes's policy compliance status is non-compliant. Record status: historical. - Professor Reyes shall receive a copy of the student's accommodation letter and a summary of relevant policy.
- OAR shall provide a general reminder to all faculty in the Department of Environmental Chemistry regarding service animal accommodations and the process for requesting clarification from OAR.
